title: 第二十一章 擎天巨象出战第二十二章 重伤
content_zh:
黑色巨龙在被灭神玄剑刺中的时候，它的仰天怒吼也是响彻天际的。只是令战神殿外的两族强者感到疑惑的是，刚刚是何人发出如此强悍的一击？
是那个炼体三重境的少年吗？
不可能的，一个炼体三重境实力的人，不说该如何能够发起如此强烈一击，就算他能够施展出如此强大的攻击手段，他的肉身也是无法承受这一切的。
那也就是说，战神殿中还隐藏着一位绝世强者吗？难道是那少年口中的恩师现身了吗？
而若是战神殿中还隐藏着一位绝世强者，那么一切也就说的通了。很多魔族的人，内心也是不得不感叹，小小堃国，还真是卧虎藏龙啊！
与战神殿外的人魔两族强者不同，战神殿后院的吞天巨猿却是能够清楚知道战神殿中的战况的。武书在精神力方面的实力，简直太强大了，这一切不仅是让吞天巨猿感到震惊的，更加是让吞天巨猿都不敢相信自己所感知到的一切的。
一个十多岁的少年，与魔族老祖一战，顷刻间动用了未曾听闻的强大精神力。
难道只因为他姓武吗？难道如今的武家已经强大到，随便拉出来一个族人，其实力都能这么可怕的吗？可是厚土大陆上的人，包括武家的人，都是善于炼体的，至于在精神力方面的修炼，绝对都是战五渣级别的。
只是，此战魔族老祖败了，武书胜了。武书依靠自身强大的精神力，以强大的姿态碾压了他的对手，魔族老祖。
也是看向战神殿中，吞天巨猿意味深长道，“好小子，真是有武家老祖的风范啊！”
与战神殿之外的众人不同，在将魔族老祖的魔气分身击败后，武书并没有放松警惕。武书是沉着冷静的看向巨象道，“别装了，虽说你将自己的气息隐匿的很好，但在我的面前，你的伪装就是个笑话。”
“哈哈哈……”
“多么狂妄的小子啊？此次前来巨象山脉，还真是惊喜不断啊？”
在武书将话说完后，便是又有一道阴森的黑魔气从巨象身体中溢出，然后就听到一个阴森的声音从战神殿东南角落传来。
冷冷的瞥了一眼声源处，武书平静道，“本以为，你会一直这么躲下去，没想到你会这么着急的想死？”
声源处，是一位魔族青年，青年双眼冰寒，神情冷漠。
竟然已经暴露，青年并不打算继续隐藏，他是抬步就向武书走去。同时，青年傲然道，“人族小子，你的确很强，堃国之中会有你这号人物存在，的确是我所没有料想到的。”
也是知道武书是来自武家，青年又是道，“不过，竟然你是来自那个家族，就算你天生拥有神力，在我看来也是一件正常事情。”
来自那个家族吗？
武书只想说，你是不是有什么误解？如今武家是何种境遇，没有人比他武书更清楚。

如今武家都已经堕落到，在这小小的东宿城都要看人脸色行事了。
还什么天生神力？要是现在武家拥有一位能够力战群雄的绝代天骄，武书都会打心底谢天谢地了。
对青年上上下下打量了一番，武书质问道，“你又是何人？”
眼前的青年拥有一副人畜无害的面孔，只是在武书强大的精神力感知下，武书能够清楚感知到，眼前的青年很不寻常。这青年身上所散发出的精神波动，是让武书感到忌惮的。
“我是谁吗？我想，这件事，你是不会想知道的。小小堃国，会同时出现两位魔族祖级强者，不知道，该说这是堃国的不幸，还是堃国的幸运呢？”
青年说话的语气是十分自负的，说话方式也是十分老道的。不管如何，武书是不喜欢这样的青年的，只因为他是魔族的人，只因为他来自巨象山脉是有目的的。
但凡能对堃国及自己的家人造成致命危险的存在，在武书看来，这种隐患都需要趁现在抹除。
也是不想与青年多费口舌，毕竟无论如何青年也是不会说出武书想要听到的事情的，武书冷冷道，“封！天下皆凡人！”
随着武书再次动用精神力，整个战神殿中的一切都像失去了灵气一般，战神殿中的一切看上去都像是凡物，武书与魔族青年看上去也只是两个普通人罢了。
战神殿中这突如其来的变化，是十分突然的，而这一切的源头都来自武书，魔族青年的脸色也是因此变得更加阴冷。
在封禁大阵成型后，武书平静道，“听闻，魔族之人，修炼手段繁多，猜的没错的话，那些正在不断吞噬战神殿之中精神力的虫子都是你释放出来的吧？”
“只是，在借用了大地之力而施展出来的这个封禁大阵面前，你的那些虫子以及你还有什么手段与我一战。在这个大阵中，你我皆只是血肉之体。”
在听到武书的话后，魔族青年也是出现了短暂的愣神，然而在有力的握了握几下拳头后，魔族青年不由大笑出，“哈哈哈……小子，你真是作茧自缚啊？炼体三重境的废物，竟然敢放弃自身强大的精神力攻击手段，选择与老祖我肉搏，真是愚不可及啊？”
content_en:
When the black dragon was stabbed by the God-Destroying Mysterious Sword, its roar resounded throughout the sky. But what puzzled the powerful men of the two races outside the War Temple was, who had just delivered such a powerful blow?
Is he that young man who is in the third level of body refining?
It was impossible. How could a person with the strength of the third level of body refining be able to launch such a powerful attack? Even if he could unleash such a powerful attack method, his physical body would not be able to withstand it all.
In other words, is there still a peerless powerful man hidden in the Temple of War? Could it be that the mentor that the young man said appeared?
And if there is a peerless powerful man hidden in the Temple of War, then everything would make sense. Many people from the demon clan have to sigh in their hearts, the little Kun Kingdom is really a crouching tiger, hidden dragon!
Unlike the powerful men and demons outside the War Temple, the sky-swallowing giant ape in the backyard of the War Temple is able to clearly understand the battle situation in the War Temple. Wu Shu's mental strength was simply too strong. All this not only shocked the Sky-Swallowing Giant Ape, but also made the Sky-Swallowing Giant Ape unable to believe everything he sensed.
A teenage boy, fighting against the ancestor of the demon clan, instantly used unheard of powerful mental power.
Is it just because his surname is Wu? Could it be that the Wu family is so powerful now that any member of the clan can be so terrifying in strength? However, people on the Houtu Continent, including people from the Wu family, are all good at physical training. As for spiritual training, they are definitely at the level of the five scum.
However, the demon clan ancestor lost this battle and Wu Shu won. Wu Shu relied on his strong mental power to crush his opponent, the ancestor of the demon clan, with a powerful posture.
Also looking at the Temple of War, the Sky-Eating Giant Ape said meaningfully, "Good boy, you really have the style of the ancestor of the Wu family!"
Unlike everyone outside the Temple of War, Wu Shu did not relax his vigilance after defeating the demonic clone of the demon ancestor. Wu Shu looked at the giant elephant calmly and said, "Stop pretending. Although you hide your aura very well, in front of me, your disguise is just a joke."
"Hahaha..."
"What an arrogant boy? Are you really surprised when you come to the Giant Elephant Mountains this time?"
After Wu Shu finished speaking, another gloomy black demonic energy overflowed from the giant elephant's body, and then he heard a gloomy voice coming from the southeast corner of the Temple of War.
Glancing coldly at the source of the sound, Wu Shu said calmly, "I thought you would keep hiding like this, but I didn't expect you to be so anxious to die?"
The source of the voice was a demon youth with cold eyes and an indifferent expression.
It turned out to be exposed. The young man did not intend to hide anymore. He walked towards Wu Shu. At the same time, the young man said proudly, "Human boy, you are indeed very strong. I did not expect that a person like you would exist in Kun Country."
Knowing that Wu Shu came from the Wu family, the young man said, "However, you are from that family. Even if you are born with divine power, it is a normal thing in my opinion."
From that family?
Wu Shu just wants to say, do you have any misunderstanding? No one knows the situation of the Wu family better than Wu Shu.
Nowadays, the Wu family has fallen to the point that in this small Dongsu City, everything depends on people's faces.
What kind of natural power is there? If the Wu family now has a peerless genius who can fight against all the heroes, Wu Shu would be grateful to God from the bottom of his heart.
After looking the young man up and down, Wu Shu asked, "Who are you?"
The young man in front of him has a face that is harmless to humans and animals. However, with Wu Shu's powerful mental perception, Wu Shu can clearly sense that the young man in front of him is very unusual. The mental fluctuations emanating from this young man made Wu Shu feel afraid.
"Who am I? I think you don't know how to do thisWondering. In the small country of Kun, two powerful ancestors of the demon clan will appear at the same time. I don’t know, should I say this is the misfortune of the country, or the luck of the country? "
The young man's tone of voice was very conceited, and his way of speaking was also very sophisticated. No matter what, Wu Shu doesn't like such a young man, just because he is from the demon clan, just because he comes from the Giant Elephant Mountains for a purpose.
Any existence that can cause fatal danger to Kun Guo and his family, in Wu Shu's opinion, such hidden dangers need to be eliminated now.
He also didn’t want to waste words with the young man. After all, the young man would not say what Wu Shu wanted to hear anyway. Wu Shu said coldly, “Feng! Everyone in the world is mortal! "
As Wu Shu used his mental power again, everything in the War Temple seemed to have lost its aura. Everything in the War Temple looked like mortal objects. Wu Shu and the demon youth looked like just two ordinary people.
This sudden change in the Temple of War was very sudden, and the source of all this came from martial arts, and the face of the demon youth became even colder because of this.
After the sealing formation was formed, Wu Shu said calmly, "I heard that people from the demon clan have many ways to practice. If your guess is correct, the insects that are constantly devouring the spiritual power in the Temple of War were released by you, right? "
"It's just that in front of this sealing formation that borrowed the power of the earth, your bugs and what other means you have can fight against me. In this great formation, you and I are just flesh and blood. "
After hearing Wu Shu's words, the demon youth was stunned for a short time. However, after shaking his fist vigorously a few times, the demon youth couldn't help but laugh out loud, "Hahaha... Boy, are you really trapping yourself? A waste in the third level of body refining actually dares to give up his powerful mental power attack method and choose to fight with the ancestor me. How stupid is he? "
